crossRefs.note: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?
Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them: you restore me, and cause me to live.
Aren’t you from everlasting, Yahweh my God, my Holy One? We will not die. Yahweh, you have appointed him for judgment.…
But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be…
For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be…
I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not…
God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next…
But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
‘Yahweh has produced our righteousness: come, and let’s declare in Zion the work of Yahweh our God.’

translations.web: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.
translations.bsb: I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.
translations.kjv: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.
translations.asv: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of Jehovah.
